title: The Diverse Prague
owner: Institute of Planning and Development (IPR Prague); local reconstruction by PGMaps
summary: Prague is a city of diversity – cultural, architectural, urban.
sourceNote: Reconstructed from the user-supplied desktop capture of The Diverse Prague. Original text, media, analysis and credits belong to IPR Prague and its credited authors. Map services remain live external dependencies; this is a local recreation, not an IPR publication.
details: Preserves the original story sequence, text, video cover, photographs, diagrams, map layers, comparisons and numbered photo tours.
Uses PGMaps navigation and reusable story components. MapLibre renders original thematic layers over the shared PGMaps basemap that follows light/dark mode; its local style uses CARTO vector tiles.
The accompanying mobile capture was empty. Responsive behavior is checked against the current public story.
Imported data excludes account credentials, telemetry and the original application code.
Four of the 19 captured WebMap definitions use unavailable original map services. The same failures are present in the supplied capture; no historical imagery is substituted.
